subject: expression: pushdown add_date/sub_date expressions to tikv (#56298)
summary: Enables TiKV pushdown for DATE_ADD/DATE_SUB and ADDDATE/SUBDATE by adding them to the TiKV pushdown whitelist, wiring PB signature decoding for AddDate/SubDate (including duration→datetime signatures), and tightening TiFlash MPP window frame pushdown eligibility checks via CanExprsPushDown.
